entries.title: PostReady: PR #915 — One welcome popup, business name at signup
entries.description: Onboarding wizard replaced with a single welcome popup; business name is collected at signup to personalise the product from the first moment.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #914 — Cut onboarding from six screens to two
entries.description: Onboarding flow condensed from six screens to two, dramatically reducing friction for new users getting started with PostReady.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #913 — Carousel Builder three-column redesign
entries.description: Carousel Builder workspace redesigned to a three-column layout, improving editorial flow and giving creators more space to work with cards and settings side by side.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #912 — Point every customer-facing address at the one monitored inbox
entries.description: All customer-facing email addresses now route to the single monitored inbox, ensuring no customer communication is missed.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #911 — Daily operations brief to info@zippityone.com
entries.description: Automated daily operations brief email delivered to the primary business inbox — keeps Pete informed of platform activity without requiring manual dashboard checks.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #910 — Admin alerts routed to correct email address
entries.description: Admin alert emails now route to the address Pete actually reads, ensuring critical system notifications reach him reliably.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #930 — Fix X quota registry for pay-per-use
entries.description: X retired Free/Basic/Pro tiers on 6 Feb 2026. Pete's account is pay-per-use. PR #930 corrects the quota registry so X shows no artificial monthly cap.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #931 — Warn before link goes into caption signature
entries.description: Caption signature is appended to every post on every channel. PR #931 warns users before a booking URL silently turns every X post into a link post (penalised with lower reach and higher cost).

entries.title: PostReady: PR #928 — Onboarding hint foundation + create-first Post Packs hint
entries.description: Shared onboarding hint machinery (#922) plus the first real hint: a contextual nudge on the Post Packs page guiding new users to create their first pack (#923).

entries.title: PostReady: PR #929 — Land on pack after saving
entries.description: After a user saves a post to a pack, they are now redirected directly to that pack instead of being left to navigate there themselves.
